entries.title: Response to a data subject's request, Art. 12(3)
entries.scope_note: The controller provides information on action taken on a request under Arts. 15 to 22 within a set period.
entries.note: verified: Art. 12(3) read on EUR-Lex; the period may be extended by two further months where necessary, with the data subject told within the first month.
entries.duration: one month from receipt of the request

entries.title: Personal data breach notification, Art. 33(1)
entries.scope_note: The controller notifies the supervisory authority of a personal data breach within a set period where feasible.
entries.note: verified: Art. 33(1) read on EUR-Lex; notification without undue delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals.
entries.duration: 72 hours after becoming aware of the breach
